name: Posting of Amended Agenda
description: When the Board adds an item to the posted agenda by majority vote, the amended agenda is posted on the website and at the administrative office.
deadline: no later than the first business day following the meeting
quote: The agenda shall be amended to reflect the new item of business and the amended agenda shall be posted to the district’s website and at the administrative office no later than the first business day following the meeting at which the agenda was amended.
